boat: Most people take the MS Gjende boat one way along the lake. The timetable changes every season and is deliberately not in this app — check the current one with the operator before you plan the day.
notNavigation: This is a planning tool. It has no position fix, no compass and no live weather. Besseggen is exposed, the scramble is real, and the weather turns fast — carry a map and compass and check conditions before you go.

terrain.name: Nasjonal høydemodell DTM1
terrain.accuracy: The source is a 1 m lidar terrain model. This app holds it resampled to 2 m along the route, 4 m for 800 m either side, 8 m out to 4 km, 16 m across the rest of the detailed box and 64 m for the horizon ring. Heights carry the source's own error, which on open mountain is a few decimetres and on a cliff or under water is worse: lidar reads the water surface, so the ground under Gjende sits at the lake's own level.

trails.name: Turrutebasen (Tur- og friluftsruter)
trails.licence: Open data — no conditions apply to access and use
trails.accuracy: Route geometry is generalised and largely contributed by clubs, associations and individuals, so quality varies by route. The Besseggen line is not labelled "Besseggen" in the source; it was assembled as the shortest marked path from Gjendesheim to Memurubu.

route.howMeasured: The line is resampled every 25 m and its heights are read off the 2 m terrain, then smoothed with a three-sample box. Without that smoothing the same line gives 1154 m of ascent, and read at the source's own vertex spacing it gives 1196 m — a 1 m model counts boulders as climbing. The figure shown is the smoothed one.

mapData.name: N50 Kartdata
mapData.note: Lakes, rivers and glaciers, for kommunes 3434 Lom and 3435 Vågå. Gjende arrives cut at the kommune border and is rejoined here. N50 states a lake's height as a whole metre; the surface drawn in the app is the water level the lidar reads, floored at that integer and lifted a decimetre, and each lake carries both figures.

placeNames.name: Sentralt stedsnavnregister (SSR)
placeNames.note: Heights are sampled from the terrain: SSR carries none.

app.offline: Everything is bundled. The app makes no network requests of any kind and reads no device sensor.
